card.name: Final piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a capitalized brand name split into parts, such as the Q in TECENTRIQ, the q in Angeliq, or IVA in SPIRIVA. It is strongest in prescribing-information text.

modes.label: TECENTRIQ ending
modes.description: The Q that completes TECENTRIQ, usually before HYBREZA or a dosing phrase.

modes.label: Other brand name endings
modes.description: The closing piece of other brand names such as Angeliq, SPIRIVA and AUVELITY.

card.plain: It fires on the final syllable of a brand drug name that the model has to read in several pieces.
